thread:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: P1 detected - edge POP eu-central-1 reporting sustained packet loss and elevated 502/504 rates for cdn.redwood.ai. Alerting SRE rotation and NetOps. Triggered 2002509999

Alex K: saw the alert, assigning initial triage. @SRE Oncall — can you pick this up? Any indication of DNS or origin issues yet?

SRE Oncall: taking it. quick checklist: 1) confirm scope, 2) check BGP/peering, 3) check POP health & host metrics, 4) invoke CDN failover if needed. I'll run traceroute/mtr and query edge logs.

Maria V: pulling edge metrics now — seeing packet loss ~15-25% from eu-central POP to several last-mile ISPs, RTT spikes ~150-400ms, 502 rate up ~8% of requests. A subset of customers reporting timeouts. No config deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot.

Deploy Bot: no deploys in last 60 minutes for service=cdn-edge

Alex K: ok sounds like a network/regional issue. @NetOps can you check BGP feeds and upstream carrier flaps?

NetOps: seeing BGP withdraws from AS65012 (carrier-B) hitting our eBGP session at 11:08 UTC. Several prefixes transiently withdrawn then re-advertised. Correlated with alert. Pinging upstreams shows packetloss on path via carrier-B.

SRE Oncall: grabbing mtr from a healthy POP -> eu-central edge

SRE Oncall: ```
# mtr -r -c 100 eu-central-pop-01.cdn.redwood.ai
 1. 10.0.0.1  0.4%  1.2 ms
 2. 192.168.200.1  0.0%  4.3 ms
 3. 203.0.113.5  12.8%  56.2 ms  # carrier-B transit
 4. 198.51.100.23  20.7%  78.9 ms
 5. eu-central-pop-01.cdn.redwood.ai  22.3%  120.1 ms
```

SRE Oncall: confirms path-level packetloss starts at carrier-B hop. Suspect upstream routing instability or partial fiber/congestion.

Priya R: I'm on-call next shift starting in 30m. @SRE Oncall if you want to hand off, let me know. I can open carrier ticket.

Alex K: please open a Sev ticket with carrier-B and ask for immediate eyeballs + BGP logs. Also create a temporary traffic steering rule to de-prioritize carrier-B for eu-central POP.

Diego L: I can apply traffic-steer policy in CDN control plane. Suggest: prefer alternate carriers (carrier-A, carrier-C) and shift 60% of new sessions away from eu-central-pop for 15 minutes. Rollback if error rate increases elsewhere.

SRE Oncall: do it. Diego, when you flip it, please post the exact config snippet.

Diego L: applying now. snippet:
```
cdn_steering {
  scope: 'eu-central-1'
  prefer_edges: ['eu-west-1','eu-north-1']
  avoid_carriers: ['AS65012']
  session_shift_pct: 60
  ttl: 900
}
```

Diego L: applied. Traffic shift initiated at 2002510100. Observability: streaming errors and latency in dashboard.

Maria V: after steer, error rate from eu-central dropped from 8% -> 3% in 2 minutes. Packetloss on monitored flows via carrier-B still high but our users hit alternate POPs now. Customer impact reduced but still present for long-lived connections pinned to eu-central POP.

NetOps: carrier-B acknowledging degraded paths; they've opened escalation with network ops and provided BGP RIB snapshots. They report a partial hardware issue in one of their aggregation routers. ETA unknown.

SRE Oncall: mitigation checklist updated: 1) traffic-steer applied, 2) enable aggressive TCP keepalive/probe to shorten pinned sessions where possible, 3) start rate-limited retries on client-facing proxy to reduce 502 surface, 4) inform support/CS.

Priya R: taking point on carrier ticket and customer comms. I'll notify Support to prepare msg for impacted customers (EU region) with guidance and ETA TBD.

Alex K: @Support — please prepare brief: status summary, affected region, temporary mitigation (traffic steering), suggested workaround (retry client requests / switch to eu-west endpoint if pinned). Keep it high level.

Support: drafting now. ETA 10m.

SRE Oncall: running live checks for sticky sessions. We can attempt to invalidate some session pins by bumping the LB cookie TTL for new allocations. Will only do if error rate doesn't improve.

Maria V: quick note: embedding-level customers using long-polling still see failures; consider advising them to reconnect to alternate region until resolved.

Priya R: carrier says they can replace hardware but it'll take >2h. We'll keep steering and try to offload more traffic. I'll request carrier temporary re-route via a different metro if possible.

NetOps: opened emergency IX peering with carrier-A for eu-central mesh; could be ~20-30m to propagate.

Diego L: started additional edge warmup in eu-west to handle increased load. CPU and network headroom checked.

SRE Oncall: measurement 10m after steer: eu-central 502s down to 1.5%, packetloss on monitored tenant flows via carrier-B down slightly but still >5%. Overall user-facing errors ~0.8% across EU.

Alex K: good progress. Priya, please take lead and I'll stay until you confirm handoff. Document what you've done in the ticket.

Priya R: taking over. Handoff: SRE Oncall -> Priya R at 2002510800. My pager is on. Actions I'm taking: 1) coordinate with carrier for reroute, 2) continue traffic-steer for 60m windows, 3) ask Support to send customer advisory, 4) monitor edge health and re-run mtr/pcap as needed.

SRE Oncall: handing off logs and current playbook to @Priya R. Leaving notes: do not change origin config unless confirmed; prefer steering over origin failover to avoid cache stampede.

Incident Bot: Handoff recorded. Primary: Priya R, Secondary: Alex K. Incident state: mitigated -> partial. Expected next update in 15m.

Support: advisory drafted. ```
Status: We are experiencing elevated errors from customers connecting to eu-central region. Mitigation: traffic steering to alternate POPs reduced impact. Users who are pinned to eu-central may still see errors. Working with upstream carrier.```

Support: posting to affected customer list now and tagging accounts that reported errors.

NetOps: carrier reports they have isolated failing linecard and will schedule hot-swap in 90-120 minutes; interim: they are steering traffic around the node where possible.

Diego L: increased session_shift_pct to 85% at 2002511600 to further reduce exposure.

Maria V: after increase, global EU error rate ~0.3%. eu-central residual 502s ~0.7% and falling. Long-lived sessions still affected but represent small percent of traffic.

Priya R: updating carrier ticket with RIB dumps and timestamps. Asking for time estimates and whether they can do more aggressive reroutes. Also putting request to legal for customer impact assessment for top-10 accounts.

Alex K: good. When carrier confirms repair, we should gradually revert steering and observe for regression for 30m.

NetOps: carrier confirms hardware swap completed at 2002513300 and BGP session stable. They report 0% packet loss on test probes now.

SRE Oncall: running mtr/traceroute checks - observed packetloss dropped to <1% across previous hops. Rolling traffic back slowly.

Diego L: starting revert: reduce avoid_carriers remove AS65012 from avoid list and set session_shift_pct -> 30% at 2002513400.

Maria V: metrics: eu-central errors back to baseline ~0.05%. No new customer complaints in last 15m.

Priya R: closing customer advisory with resolution note and follow-up postmortem planned. Asking Support to wait for final stability window (30m) before sending final note.

Alex K: great teamwork. Postmortem owners: Priya R (lead), NetOps (carrier comms), Maria V (metrics). Please include timeline, impact numbers (peak affected %), mitigation steps, and recommendation (automated traffic-steer on BGP withdraw thresholds).

Priya R: acknowledged. I'll open a postmortem doc and invite owners. Closing incident channel in 30m if stable.

Incident Bot: Incident status -> resolved (mitigated then resolved) at 2002513600. Incident closed pending postmortem.

Alex K: marking incident as resolved. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
